# scripts/host/Install-ProfileUnityConsole.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Runs ON the ProfileUnity console VM: downloads the console installer from the media account with the VM's own managed identity and checks its SHA-256 against the lock entry.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-MediaAccountName` | string | no | `''` |  |
| `-Blob` | string | no | `''` |  |
| `-Sha256` | string | no | `''` |  |
| `-StorageSuffix` | string | no | `'core.windows.net'` |  |
| `-Destination` | string | no | `'C:\ProgramData\avd-liquidware\media'` |  |
